6.text: Kroger is spending $5 billion to cut prices and revamp promotions after losing market share to Walmart and Costco. Other pieces cover rising toy prices, CVS courting rival pharmacy customers, $100 billion in CPG delivery losses, and consumer value-seeking.

5.text: Walmart shares rose to $121.12, are up 12% over the past year and roughly 10.5% in a month, and trade near 42.8 times trailing earnings. Evercore ISI raised its price target to $130, while analysts debated whether the stock is too expensive.

11.text: Costco shares are down over 18% from their May 2026 peak, and Costco trades at the highest price-to-earnings multiple among six large retailers including Walmart, ranking fifth of six on operating metrics. Target has raised its dividend for over five decades but rising capital spending and tightening free cash flow threaten the streak; Walmart is mentioned only as a valuation comparison.

14.text: Walmart bundled Walmart+ and Sam’s Club Plus for $120 yearly, added eight parcel carriers for seller-fulfilled shipping, and expanded Flipkart’s employee food-delivery test. It also introduced AI agent profiles and gateway tools, while reports noted its growing advertising business.

7.text: Walmart is adding a new shopping perk aimed at competing with Costco. Meanwhile, discount grocer Best Bargains is closing all stores under a Chapter-7-style receivership amid struggles among bargain grocers.
